verdict.rationale: Bland documents infrastructure versioning concepts (staged/canary rollouts, choosing when to adopt a new release, draft vs. production pathway versions) but there is no evidence of a documented API versioning scheme (e.g., v1/v2 endpoints) or an explicit deprecation policy for its APIs, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s. missing for 10: documented API version numbering/endpoints, an explicit deprecation/sunset policy for APIs, published OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation of versioning practices.
